officialInventory.summary: National parks, hunting zones and MPAs are PA categories under the wildlife regime (Décret 2011-394); Pendjari NP is under delegated management (6NR). The NBSAP Tableau 1 (DGFRN 2013) gives official counts by category (2 national parks, 4 zones cynégétiques, 46 forêts classées, 6 périmètres de reboisement) but no names; two MPAs were created in 2022. cenagref.net was not used (reported hijacked).

areas.name: Parc National de la Pendjari
areas.notes: Atacora. Part of the W-Arly-Pendjari World Heritage complex and Pendjari Biosphere Reserve; managed under delegation (6NR). Coordinates = central point given in the WHC nomination. Area/legal act not documented in sources seen (NBSAP gives 869,867 ha for the two national parks combined).

areas.name: Parc National du W (Bénin)
areas.notes: Alibori/Atacora. Part of the W-Arly-Pendjari World Heritage complex. Coordinates = central point in the WHC nomination.

areas.name: Zone cynégétique de la Pendjari
areas.notes: Hunting zone south of Pendjari NP. The WHC nomination names the hunting areas of Konkombri and Mékrou as part of the Pendjari/Atacora hunting zones; the 2017 WHC supplement says the Konkombri and Mékrou hunting zones have the same protection status as national parks except for sport hunting.

areas.name: Zone cynégétique de l'Atacora
areas.notes: Hunting zone between Pendjari and W national parks (see Pendjari ZC note on Konkombri/Mékrou).

areas.name: Zone cynégétique de la Djona
areas.notes: East of W National Park (WHC nomination).

notEnumerated.reason: No official list found; counts conflict (46 in NBSAP/DGFRN 2013, 56 in 6NR).
About 2,940 sacred forests (18,360 ha); no list.
Only two ACCB arrêtés were found (6NR); others (e.g. Dèmè-Lokoli-Koussoukpa community reserve mentioned in NBSAP) lack documented legal status.

gaps: Only three of the four zones cynégétiques could be named (Pendjari, Atacora, Djona); the relationship of the Konkombri and Mékrou hunting areas to them is ambiguous in UNESCO documents.
Creation acts, years and individual areas of Pendjari NP, W NP and the hunting zones were not documented in sources seen.
The text of Décret n° 2022-003 (MPAs) was not seen; areas of the two MPAs unknown.
Benin's 'réserves de faune' and 'sanctuaires' categories (Décret 2011-394) had no named examples in sources seen.
